name: push
description: Notifications for Android and iOS: remote push (Firebase Cloud Messaging on Android, APNs on iOS) and local notifications scheduled by the game (categories / tags to cancel groups, repeat). Protocol: push (docs/plugins.md, engine/services/Push.h). Config: channel {id, name} (Android), firebase {applicationId, apiKey, projectId, senderId} (Android remote push; without it only local notifications), icon (Android small icon drawable name), askOnStart (request the permission at init).
